== FINDINGS ==

  Total: 0 CRITICAL, 1 WARNING, 3 INFO

  [WARN] (impact: persistent) #1: RTX Spark Developer Preview Driver (rtx-spark-driver-developer-preview)
    Evidence:     Driver 616.00 (nv_surface_woa.inf) is the RTX Spark Developer Preview branch (R616, 2026-07-16, S24); below 616.00 on Arm64 is an extracted/unofficial build.
    Why:          NVIDIA lists the preview stack as pre-release, not for production or benchmarking (S26 release notes), with the known issue 'Possible system instability during PyTorch build workflows' (S24 landing page). (The v1 '~2 min blank display during install' claim had no source and was dropped.)
    Next Steps:
      • Check the RTX Spark Developer Preview thread (S24) and OEM/Windows Update for a production Arm64 driver (read-only).
      ! Advisory: installing a different driver replaces the Developer Preview package (revert: reinstall the 616.00 DP package from the S24 thread).

  [INFO] #2: Unified Memory: nvidia-smi Memory Fields Are [N/A] by Design (unified-memory-nvsmi-expected)
    Evidence:     nvidia-smi memory '[N/A]' on GPU 0 (NVIDIA RTX Spark N1X (6144-core Blackwell RTX GPU)) is expected on unified-memory iGPUs. Pool: MemTotal 128.0 GiB measured from Win32_OperatingSystem TotalVisibleMemorySize. MemAvailable 100.0 GiB, swap 0.0 GiB. Fan, power limit, memory clock and PCIe gen/width are also [N/A] or misreported ('GEN 1@ 1x', S7).
    Why:          Suppresses low-vram, fan, power-limit and PCIe false alarms; cudaMemGetInfo also under-reports.
    Next Steps:
      • Use /proc/meminfo MemAvailable (+SwapFree), free -h 'available' or the DGX Dashboard (http://localhost:11000).

  [INFO] #3: NVIDIA RTX Spark (N1X) Detected (rtx-spark-detected)
    Evidence:     RTX Spark N1X (6144-core, DEV_2E03), Windows build 26100 ARM64, Microsoft Surface RTX Spark Dev Box, pool 128.0 GiB (Win32_OperatingSystem.TotalVisibleMemorySize).
    Why:          Unified memory and Windows-on-Arm change what nvidia-smi, AdapterRAM (uint32) and CUDA report.
    Next Steps:
      • Report total RAM as the GPU pool; record driver version and INF.

  [INFO] #4: nvidia-smi Not Found (may be absent on RTX Spark) (nvidia-smi-missing)
    Evidence:     The nvidia-smi utility was not found. Whether the RTX Spark Arm64 driver package ships nvidia-smi.exe is unconfirmed (spec 2.2), so this is informational.
    Why:          Without nvidia-smi the GPU, thermal and PCIe samples come from WMI only; memory is the unified pool (Win32_OperatingSystem.TotalVisibleMemorySize), not AdapterRAM.
    Next Steps:
      • If a later RTX Spark driver adds nvidia-smi.exe, re-run NVCheckup for the fuller sample set.
